newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end mixed in slow trading, Suria shines.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end mixed in slow trading, Suria shines.

text.p: The stock of financial firm Suria Capital shined on merger hopes, bucking a generally lacklustre trend among most other issues, dealers and analysts said on Monday.
At the close, the key Composite Index was down 0.11 points to 1,117.20.
Institutions were mostly sidelined while retail players chased up the usual bunch of speculative issues, they said.
"There's nothing today. We have the same stories with nothing changed," said an insitutional dealer at a large stockbroking house.
Suria stock jumped 23 cents or 8.3 percent to 3.00 ringgit on renewed hopes of a merger with financial firm MBf Capital . MBf Capital was suspended pending an announcement.
Acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim confirmed that the two companies may be heading for a merger.
"On the Suria-MBf Capital merger, I am not in a position to comment on anything because I have not seen the proposals.
"However I was told that it has been sent to either the Treasury or Central Bank," he told reporters when asked about market speculation of a merger.
